system: Yakıt Ölçümü & Hava Emiş / Kam Mili Zamanlaması
symptoms: Check the engine oil level and quality: Low oil or dirty oil can cause problems with the VVT system, so ensure that the oil is at the correct level and is clean.
Inspect the camshaft position sensor and VVT solenoid: These components may be faulty and need to be replaced. A professional technician can perform tests to determine their functionality.

Check the engine's timing: The timing chain or belt may have slipped or become worn, causing the camshaft to be out of sync. In such cases, the timing components may need to be inspected and replaced if necessary.

questions.text: Incorrect camshaft timing durumunu kontrol ettiniz mi?

pass_next: Canlı veride sinyal nominal ise arıza hafızasını silin.
fail_next: İlgili bileşeni veya kablo demetini onarın/değiştirin.
